name: @molis-ai/molis-work-module-shelf
description: Shelf, the platform's personal shelf: items, copy-jobs, hashes, local text extraction, and the surface the runtime hosts as system.shelf.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && esbuild src/surface/browser/factory.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --charset=utf8 '--banner:js=(host) => {' --footer:js=} --outfile=dist/surface/shelf-client.js && node ../../scripts/client-literals.mjs --factory dist/surface/shelf-client.js && esbuild src/surface/browser/settings/factory.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --charset=utf8 --outfile=dist/surface/shelf-settings-client.js && node ../../packages/plugin-sdk/tooling/build-native-markdown.mjs prompts
